searchText: We have `eth_gasPrice` what if we add `eth_gasPrices` that return estimations for all the dimensions as an array? [0xgas, 0xblobgas]. What do you think guys? That requires implicit knowledge of the order in which the value are returned, would an object with keys be a better option _e.g._ `{"gas":"0x...","blob_gas":"0x..."}`? Looks more convenient indeed! Array implied that at some point we would not care about every dimension's name, but it's not something considerable in the near future I guess Apologies if this is obvious to everyone but who would the `to` be in a 4844 transaction? For more context see here https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844#blob-transaction thanks so much Any contract address or externally-owned-account, but not null (as opposed to type-2, type-1, or type-0 transactions where null creates a contract). thanks for the prompt reply, I guess is there any field in the transaction or its receipt that ties it to a specific origin rollup? I'm guessing that (ideally) each rollup should have its smart contract with internal logic, ideally they should check the blobs included in the transaction using the `BLOBHASH` opcode, but either way, the blobs will end up making its way to the beacon chain, regardless of the address called in the `to` field hmm, I think I was expecting that the rollups (via a smart contract or EOA) would play some role in triggering or receiving these txs, I think I probably need to do more research on the flow 🙂 Yes I think the implementation details would be better explained by the rollup devs, the rollups should be the ones sending the transactions, and also in charge of putting in place some smart contract that receives these transactions and processes them, but yes it's going to be different for every rollup got it, interesting you say it's going to be different for every rollup though, maybe a question for the <#829412277782315008>

excerpts.author: marianna_metrika
excerpts.content: Apologies if this is obvious to everyone but who would the `to` be in a 4844 transaction? For more context see here https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844#blob-transaction thanks so much

excerpts.author: marioevz
excerpts.content: Any contract address or externally-owned-account, but not null (as opposed to type-2, type-1, or type-0 transactions where null creates a contract).
